post.description: Create a browser-bound QR code session for the given social connector and return the QR code image (PNG data URI) with the session's verification ID and expiry. Dev feature.

200.description: The QR code session has been created.

verificationId.description: The unique verification ID of the newly created Social verification record. Use this ID for polling, cancellation, and the verify call.

qrCode.description: The QR code image as a PNG data URI, rendered from the connector-provided QR content URL.

expiresAt.description: The session expiry time in epoch milliseconds.

404.description: The social connector is not found.

422.description: Dev features are disabled, or the connector does not support QR code sign-in.

500.description: The connector failed to create the QR code (e.g. WeChat API error) or the request was superseded by a newer session.

get.summary: Get social QR code session status
get.description: Poll the status of a QR code session owned by the current interaction. Returns `pending`, `confirmed` (a qualifying WeChat event has been received and stored), or `expired`. No state is consumed by polling. Dev feature.

status.description: The QR code session status. `confirmed` sessions still need to be consumed through the verify endpoint; `expired` sessions cannot be verified.

404.description: The verification record is not found in the current interaction.

400.description: The connector rejected the request (e.g. invalid configuration).

422.description: Dev features are disabled, or the connector does not support QR code sign-in.

delete.description: Invalidate (cancel) the QR code session owned by the current interaction. Idempotent; a cancelled session can no longer be confirmed or consumed. Dev feature.

204.description: The session has been invalidated, or did not exist.

404.description: The verification record is not found in the current interaction.

400.description: The connector rejected the request (e.g. invalid configuration).

422.description: Dev features are disabled, or the connector does not support QR code sign-in.
